auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Unpaid dividend of Rs 3.17 Lakhs for FY 1995-96, 1996-97, 1997-98 not deposited to IEPF; 2) Non-assessment of financial impact of four Labour Codes notified effective November 21, 2025; 3) Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative net worth and accumulated losses. Non-compliance with deposit of unpaid dividend to IEPF
Non-assessment of Labour Codes impact on employee benefits
Trade payables classification (MSME/others, disputed/undisputed) based solely on management assessment without audit evidence
